sets.title: Would have resigned, then won
sets.note: From the deep-vs-quick test (18 Nov 2026, batch zpq001: 256 deals a move, nets from zl17). In these games a seat's search valued its position under 3% twice in a row and the confirming deep search (2,048 deals) found no out, so it would have resigned; the game was played on and that seat won. About 1 in 50 resign points so far. All eight come from the quick batch; none from the deep one (zps018). Opened at the resign point.

games.title: zl17 vs zl17 (would resign)
games.note: At 4 life with one card in hand. The comeback starts two moves later: the opponent's Commit on its Dandân, Mystic Sanctuary returns Brainstorm, then Memory resets both hands to seven and Deem Inferior removes the attacker.

games.title: zl16 (would resign) vs zl17
games.note: zl16 (the rival) at 4 life against 20, after a Brainstorm. The next move swings it to 60%: Mind Bend on the opponent's only Dandân, which then has to be sacrificed for want of its land type.

games.title: zl17 (would resign) vs zl17
games.note: 4 life each. The opponent's Metamorphose on an Island lets this seat put a Dandân in, the Dandâns trade in a block, and the game is won on the opponent's empty library.

games.title: zl17 vs zl17 (would resign)
games.note: 8 against 16 life with 6 cards left in the library: a late deck-out race that the value net read as lost; the comeback comes over the next 15 moves.

games.title: zl16 vs zl17 (would resign)
games.note: zl17 at 4 life with one card, against zl16. It plays on with Commit, a Clue and a Dandân; the opponent's own Memory then refills both hands and the game turns.

games.title: zl17 (would resign) vs zl16
games.note: zl17 against zl16, resign point a third of the way in (16 life against 20, two cards). The odds stay under 10% for some 175 moves before it wins: a long grind, not one swing.

games.title: zl17 vs zl17 (would resign)
games.note: Resign point at 16 life with one card, just after its own Narset's Reversal. It stays under a third for 20 moves, then wins once the opponent's Dandân is answered.

games.title: zl16 (would resign) vs zl17
games.note: zl16 (the rival) would resign against zl17, 124 moves in, and comes back over the next 20 moves: low but steady odds, then the swing.
